description: List charges with optional filters (customer, address, status, ids, purchase item, scheduled/created/updated date ranges) and sorting. Returns { charges }. Pagination is cursor-based: pass `limit` (default 50, max 250) and read `next_cursor` / `previous_cursor` from the response. IMPORTANT: when paging with `cursor`, Recharge accepts ONLY `limit` alongside it — omit every other filter on cursor requests. Recharge REST: GET /charges.

created_at_max.description: Filter to charges created on/before this date (ISO 8601).

created_at_min.description: Filter to charges created on/after this date (ISO 8601).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (next_cursor / previous_cursor from a prior response). Use it ALONE with `limit` — omit all other filters on cursor requests.

ids.description: Comma-separated list of charge ids to fetch.

purchase_item_id.description: Filter to charges containing this purchase item (subscription/onetime line item) id.

scheduled_at.description: Filter to charges scheduled on this date (ISO 8601).

scheduled_at_max.description: Filter to charges scheduled on/before this date (ISO 8601).

scheduled_at_min.description: Filter to charges scheduled on/after this date (ISO 8601).

sort_by.description: Sort order: id-asc | id-desc | updated_at-asc | updated_at-desc | scheduled_at-asc | scheduled_at-desc.

status.description: Filter by charge status: success | queued | error | refunded | partially_refunded | skipped | pending_manual_payment | pending.

updated_at_max.description: Filter to charges updated on/before this date (ISO 8601).

updated_at_min.description: Filter to charges updated on/after this date (ISO 8601).

name: recharge_list_charges
title: List charges
